scenes.title_cn: 开场：一级校色是色彩分离与肤色平衡的起点
scenes.title_en: Opening: Primaries Are Where Color Separation Begins
scenes.context: 调色师 Natasha 回答小红薯的跟练请求，指出一切从 primaries（一级校色）开始——它是实现最佳色彩分离、最平衡肤色的地方，也是建立整张调色板的地方。
sentences: 你能做一个简短的跟练教程吗？我是完全新手。
Could you make a short follow-along tutorial? I'm a complete beginner.
follow-along tutorial（跟练教程）
一级校色是你实现最佳色彩分离的地方，也是得到最平衡肤色的地方。
Your primaries are where you achieve the best color separation and the most balanced skin tone.
color separation（色彩分离）
它决定高光、中间调、暗部各要什么颜色，对比曲线长什么样。
It sets what colors you want in your highlights, your midtones, and your lowlights, and what your contrast curve looks like.
highlights / midtones / lowlights（高光/中间调/暗部）
paraphrase: I'm brand new to grading — walk me through it.
「定下画面的颜色方向」换种说法
Primaries define the whole mood of the image.
scenes.speak: Could you make a short follow-along tutorial? I'm a complete beginner. Your primaries are where you achieve the best color separation and the most balanced skin tone. It sets what colors you want in your highlights, your midtones, and your lowlights, and what your contrast curve looks like.

scenes.title_cn: 优秀调色的秘密：一切从 primaries 开始
scenes.title_en: The Secret of Great Grading: It All Starts with Primaries
scenes.context: 任何伟大的调色师都会告诉你，一切从 primaries 开始。他们最不喜欢的是脏（dirty）和浑浊（muddy）的调色——所有颜色不自觉地混在一起，画面蒙上一层没有意图的暗沉光泽。
sentences: 如果你问任何一位伟大的调色师，他们都会告诉你，一切从 primaries 开始。
If you ask any of the great colorists, they'll tell you it all starts with their primaries.
colorist（调色师）
他们会用『脏』和『浑浊』来形容不喜欢的调色。
They describe corrections they dislike as dirty and muddy.
dirty and muddy（脏且浑浊）
一切感觉都在不自觉地混在一起，蒙上一层没有意图的光泽。
Everything feels like it's blending together with an unintentional patina over it.
patina（光泽/旧色层）
paraphrase: 「调色翻车的常见词」换种说法
Bad grades feel muddy, like a haze over the frame.
The midtones just sit on top of everything else.
scenes.speak: If you ask any of the great colorists, they'll tell you it all starts with their primaries. They describe corrections they dislike as dirty and muddy. Everything feels like it's blending together with an unintentional patina over it.

scenes.title_cn: Offset 与线性一级校色：两种工作方式
scenes.title_en: Offset and Linear Primaries: Two Ways to Work
scenes.context: 达芬奇用 Offset 复刻了胶片实验室配光师的控制。有人只用线性 primaries 做出漂亮作品，有人把 Offset 与线性结合使用——作者本人两者都用。DIT 在片场用 primaries 建立参考，dailies 调色师延续它确定全片基调。
sentences: Offset 复刻了实验室配光师拥有的那些控制。
The offset replicates the controls that the lab timers had.
lab timer（胶片配光师）
有人只用线性 primaries，有人把 Offset 和线性结合使用。
Some people use just the linear primaries; some combine the offset with linear primaries.
linear primaries（线性一级校色）
DIT 在片场用它建立参考，之后交给样片调色师确定全片基调。
The DIT creates references on set, then the dailies colorist establishes the look for the film.
dailies colorist（样片调色师）
paraphrase: They work beautifully together, not just separately.
The first look becomes the compass for the whole film.
scenes.speak: The offset replicates the controls that the lab timers had. Some people use just the linear primaries; some combine the offset with linear primaries. The DIT creates references on set, then the dailies colorist establishes the look for the film.

scenes.title_cn: 实操与边界：primaries 影响全图，压暗阴影有代价
scenes.title_en: Practice and Limits: Primaries Hit Everything, Crushing Shadows Costs
scenes.context: 用练习素材做两套冷暖设置，肤色、胡子、衬衫、牙齿颜色都随 primaries 改变。primaries 影响整幅画面而不是局部；为了人物对比度压暗阴影会丢失阴影细节，这叫 crushing the shadows。Parade 波形是检查白平衡的可靠工具。
sentences: 仅用一级校色，我就能彻底改变这个画面的情绪。
I can dramatically change the feeling of this material just with my primaries.
dramatically（彻底地）
primaries 会影响整幅画面，它不是局部工具。
Primaries affect your entire image; they're not specific to any one area.
entire image（整幅画面）
我加了太多对比度，把阴影细节都压掉了——这叫压碎阴影。
I added so much contrast that I'm eliminating the shadow detail — that's called crushing the shadows.
crushing the shadows（压碎阴影）
paraphrase: The parade scope tells you if your whites are balanced.
「局部调整换整体工具」换种说法
Primaries are global — go elsewhere for targeted fixes.
scenes.speak: I can dramatically change the feeling of this material just with my primaries. Primaries affect your entire image; they're not specific to any one area. I added so much contrast that I'm eliminating the shadow detail — that's called crushing the shadows.

practice: I want to learn color grading from scratch.
Start by building clean color separation.
「一级校色决定全片基调」用英文怎么说？
The primaries set the tone for the whole film.
「别把阴影细节压没了」怎么讲？
pitfalls: Push every image to maximum contrast for impact.
Use contrast with intent — leave detail where it matters.
Blown-out contrast crushes shadows and makes the grade look amateur.
Skip primaries and jump straight to stylized nodes.
Build the foundation with primaries before any creative grading.
Stylized looks sit on shaky ground without a solid primary base.
Judge color only on your monitor.
Check your parade scope and deliverable color space.
Colors you can't see on a monitor can appear in DCI P3 projection.
Treat primaries as a local tool.
Remember primaries are global — use masks for local tweaks.
Primaries shift every part of the image, not just one region.
shifts: 以为调色靠堆复杂节点
意识到一切从一级校色 primaries 开始
用 Parade 波形与交付色域校验白平衡
明白压碎阴影是换取对比的取舍
footer_notes: 原视频为 Natasha Leonnet 的英文调色教程（《爱乐之城》调色师），英文原文即素材，中文为意译帮助理解；调色术语（primaries/offset/DIT）保留英文原词。
